description: Header file defining utility functions, enums, and class declarations for shader translation in the ANGLE project, including type conversions, string handling, and shader variable queries.

classes.name: ImplicitTypeConversion
classes.description: Enumeration for tracking possible implicit type conversions between int/uint and float in GLSL shaders.

methods.name: atoi_clamp
methods.description: Converts string to unsigned int with overflow clamping.

methods.name: NumericLexFloat32OutOfRangeToInfinity
methods.description: Converts numeric string to float, handling out-of-range values by converting to infinity.

methods.name: strtof_clamp
methods.description: Converts string to float with overflow handling, using C locale and ensuring valid format.

methods.name: GLVariableType
methods.description: Returns the GLenum type of a shader variable.

methods.name: GLVariablePrecision
methods.description: Returns the precision qualifier of a shader variable.

methods.name: IsVaryingIn
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier indicates a varying input.

methods.name: IsVaryingOut
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier indicates a varying output.

methods.name: IsVarying
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier indicates a varying variable.

methods.name: IsGeometryShaderInput
methods.description: Determines if a qualifier is valid for geometry shader input.

methods.name: GetInterpolationType
methods.description: Gets the interpolation type for a given qualifier.

methods.name: ArrayString
methods.description: Returns array size string for a given type.

methods.name: GetTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string name of a type, with hashing and naming options.

methods.name: GetShaderVariableBasicType
methods.description: Returns the basic type of a shader variable.

methods.name: DeclareGlobalVariable
methods.description: Declares a global variable in the shader's root block.

methods.name: IsBuiltinOutputVariable
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier is a built-in output variable.

methods.name: IsBuiltinFragmentInputVariable
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier is a built-in fragment input variable.

methods.name: CanBeInvariantESSL1
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier can be invariant in ESSL 1.00.

methods.name: CanBeInvariantESSL3OrGreater
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier can be invariant in ESSL 3.00 or later.

methods.name: IsShaderOutput
methods.description: Checks if a qualifier indicates a shader output.

methods.name: IsOutputESSL
methods.description: Checks if a shader output is ESSL.

methods.name: IsOutputGLSL
methods.description: Checks if a shader output is GLSL.

methods.name: IsOutputHLSL
methods.description: Checks if a shader output is HLSL.

methods.name: IsOutputVulkan
methods.description: Checks if a shader output targets Vulkan.

methods.name: IsOutputMetal
methods.description: Checks if a shader output targets Metal.

methods.name: IsInShaderStorageBlock
methods.description: Checks if a node is within a shader storage block.

methods.name: GetImageInternalFormatType
methods.description: Returns internal format type for image layout.

methods.name: IsSpecWithFunctionBodyNewScope
methods.description: Determines if shader nesting rules apply based on spec and version.

methods.name: GetConversion
methods.description: Determines implicit conversion type between two basic types.

methods.name: IsValidImplicitConversion
methods.description: Checks if a given implicit conversion is valid for an operator.
